questions.explanation: A trumpet is sounded by vibrating the lips against its mouthpiece.

questions.explanation: Sympathetic strings vibrate in response to matching frequencies from the melody strings, enriching resonance.

questions.prompt: On an ideal string, a light touch one-third of the way along permits which lowest natural harmonic?

choices.text: An octave above the open note
Two octaves above the open note
An octave and a fifth above the open note
Two octaves and a major third above the open note

questions.hint: The touch creates a node. Find the lowest whole-number vibration pattern with a node there.
questions.explanation: The third harmonic has a node at one-third of the string and a frequency three times the fundamental: an octave plus a fifth.
